meta.label: Search Confluence Pages
meta.description: Search Confluence pages by keywords and return up to the configured number of results (default: 3)

params.name: access_type
params.label: Access type. Reviewer: hidden menu to keep for future extension

params.name: space_key
params.label: Confluence space key
params.description: Optional key of the Confluence space to restrict the search. Leave empty to search all spaces.

params.name: type
params.label: Content type
params.description: Optional Confluence content type filter (e.g. page, blogpost, attachment). Leave empty to search pages only.

params.name: search_mode
params.label: Search mode
params.description: strict_page keeps page-only default behavior; broad does not force type=page unless type is explicitly provided.

params.name: enforce_page_type
params.label: Restrict to page type by default
params.description: When enabled (default), the search uses type=page unless a type is explicitly provided.

params.name: labels
params.label: Labels
params.description: Comma-separated Confluence labels to filter results (e.g. docs,how-to).

params.name: creator
params.label: Creator
params.description: Filter by creator username or account identifier.

params.name: contributor
params.label: Contributor
params.description: Filter by contributor username or account identifier.

params.name: last_modified
params.label: Last modified
params.description: Limit results to pages updated within the selected timeframe.

params.name: order_by
params.label: Order by
params.description: Sort order for results (default: last modified descending).

params.name: limit
params.label: Documents limit
params.description: Maximum number of Confluence pages to return (default: 3).

params.name: include_debug_metadata
params.label: Include debug metadata in tool output
params.description: When enabled, output includes effective CQL and request attempts to help compare tool behavior with manual search.
